constraints: Only absolute pathnames are supported; the command does not accept relative paths.
By default the path is interpreted as POSIX syntax; a platform-specific pathname (Windows or macOS) must be flagged via the pathType parameter (fk platform path).

The optional trailing * parameter is only meaningful when the command is called from a component: it makes the command resolve against the host database instead of the component. If * is omitted when called from a component, a null object is always returned.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates and returns a 4D.File object for the file at the given path string.

discriminatedBy.rule: first argument is a Text path string

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates and returns a 4D.File object for a 4D built-in or system file designated by a file constant; returns a null object if the designated file does not currently exist.

discriminatedBy.rule: first argument is an Integer file constant
